cards.audioText: Do you have any experience of abnormal flight situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾遇到异常飞行状况么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. I remember last week I flew to Beijing. When the airplane was over the mountains, a strong turbulence came. I immediately asked the passengers to fasten their seat belts and carefully controlled the airplane because I knew it was very dangerous to fly in that situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我遇到过。记得上周我飞北京。飞机爬升到大山上空时，遭遇了强烈的颠簸气流。我马上叫乘客系好安全带，并小心操纵飞机，因为我清楚，在这种情况下飞行是非常危险的。

cards.audioText: What will you do with the passengers when encountering abnormal situation in preflight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前遇到异常情况你将如何与乘客解释？
cards.referenceText: Well, generally such abnormal situation will cause a flight delay. I will tell passengers the situation of aircraft which causes delay and give them comfort.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，通常这种异常情况会造成航班延误。我会告知乘客该状况会造成航班延误，并安抚他们。

cards.audioText: What should the pilot do when he finds problems in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在飞行中发现问题时应该怎么做？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should control the aircraft with all his effort, carry out the checklist procedures and maintain correct navigation, then he must establish proper communication with ATC. He should report the situation to the controller and inform the controller of the problem nature, his intentions, POB and dangerous cargo on board, if time permits. Then the pilot should follow the controller’ s instructions. He can also request emergency services from ATC, such as ambulance, ﬁre trucks and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应该尽全力控制飞机，执行检查单程序，并维持正确的导航，之后他必须和ATC建立适当的通话。飞行员应该向管制员报告情况，如果时间允许还应报告问题根源、他的意图、机上人员及危险货物。然后飞行员应按照管制员的指令操作。他还可以向ATC要求紧急服务，如救护车、救火车等。

cards.audioText: What would you do as a captain in the event that a heart attack passenger on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果机上有乘客心脏病发作，作为机长你应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Well, I think saving life comes first. I will request the flight attendant to look after the passenger and give him or her basic medical assistance. At the same time, I will make a passenger announcement (PA) to find if there is any doctor on board. Basically, I have to contact ATC to request a diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，我认为挽救生命是第一位的。我会要求乘务员照顾乘客，并为他/她提供基本的医疗援助。同时，我会通过客舱广播寻找机上是否有医生。基本上，我一定会联系ATC要求改航到最近的合适的机场。

cards.audioText: What will the captain perform in an emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急撤离时，机长会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: In an emergency evacuation, the captain will complete the evacuation checklist and follow the standard evacuation procedures. First he will set the parking brake. Then the captain will announce the passengers the evacuation to be executed. Meanwhile, cabin crew will open the emergency exits and organize passengers to leave the airplane orderly and timely. Usually the captain is the last one to leave the airplane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 紧急撤离时，机长将完成撤离检查单并按照标准疏散程序安排。首先他会刹车。然后机长会通知乘客执行撤离。同时，机组人员将打开安全出口并及时组织乘客有序地撤离机舱。通常，机长是最后一个离开飞机的。

cards.audioText: In an emergency situation, when would you transmit a PANPAN or MAYDAY message?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急情况下，何时会发出“PANPAN”或者“MAYDAY”信号？
cards.referenceText: When encountering an urgency condition concerning with safety, requiring timely, but not immediate assistance, I should transmit a PANPAN message to ATC. When encountering distress conditions including fire, mechanical failure or structural damage and requiring immediate assistance, I should transmit MAYDAY to ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到涉及安全问题，需要及时解决但又不能立即提供援助的紧急情况时，我应向ATC发出“PANPAN”信号。当遇到危难情况，包括火灾、机械故障或者结构损坏，需要立即援救，我会向ATC发出“MAYDAY”信号。

cards.audioText: What are the most important things to cope with an unusual event for pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在解决异常事件时最重要的是什么？
cards.referenceText: When pilots handle an unusual event, there are three steps that are the most important things to do. First, keep calm and maintain control of the aircraft. Second, correctly find out the nature and cause of the unusual event, and then carry out proper checklist. Third, contact ATC as soon as possible, inform the condition, intentions and ask for necessary help.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员处理异常事件时，有三个步骤是最重要的。首先，保持冷静、控制好飞机。其次，准确找出异常事件的本质和原因，并执行合适的清单。最后，尽快联系ATC，告知情况及我的想法，并寻求必要的帮助。

cards.audioText: What emergency assistance can you get from ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从ATC处获得何种紧急援助？
cards.referenceText: In emergency situations, ATC follows our intention and instructs us to divert or to return to land as soon as possible. It can provide us with radar vector and arrange priority landing, and inform the other aircraft in the vicinity of the emergency situation. Besides, ATC can also arrange emergency services for the aircraft after landing, including ambulances, fire truck, first-aid, tug and foam carpet (in case of belly/forced landing).
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到紧急情况时, ATC会根据我们的意图，指导我们尽快改航或返回降落。ATC可以为我们提供雷达引导，安排优先降落，并告知附近飞机该情况。另外，ATC可以在飞机降落后为其提供紧急服务，包括救护车、救火车、急救、拖车以及泡沫毯（如果发生机腹着陆或迫降）。

cards.audioText: What are the communication requirements during an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 遇到紧急情况时对交流有什么要求？
cards.referenceText: During emergency, we will first call PANPAN or MAYDAY based on the actual situation, better repeated three times. Then, we will inform ATC of the nature of our problem, information including our intention, position, heading, altitude and POB, if time permits. And if we can solve the problem later, we must cancel our emergency by saying "cancel distress/ urgency".
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到紧急情况时，首先我们会根据实际情况发出“PANPAN”或者“MAYDAY”信号，最好重复三次。之后，我们会告知ATC我们问题的原因，时间允许的话，还会告知其我们的意图、位置、航向、高度和机上人员。如果问题稍后解决了，我们必须取消紧急预警通过发出“cancel distress/ urgency”信号。

cards.audioText: In what situations the runway needs to be changed?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么情况需要更换跑道？
cards.referenceText: There are some situations in which change of runway is necessary. For example, when the airplane has some malfunctions, such as flap setting and brake failures, a long runway length for landing is required. Also, if the active runway is occupied by other aircraft or vehicles, it needs to be changed. Besides, if there are some changes in local weather conditions, like wind direction change, we should change a runway for a safe landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在一些情况下需要改变跑道，例如，如果飞机襟翼设置或刹车装置等有故障时，需要在一个更长的跑道上着陆。此外，如果使用跑道被其它飞机或车辆占用，也是需要更换跑道的。另外，如果当地的天气状况有一些改变，如风向改变，这时我们应该改变跑道，确保安全着陆。

cards.audioText: Do you consider a potential diversion airport before each departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 每次起飞之前你是否会考虑可以改航的机场？
cards.referenceText: Yes, as a qualified/professional pilot, I am always ready to handle abnormal situation and prepare for divert. Before departure we will receive a flight plan. We must review the potential divert airport listed in the flight plan and consider the situations of diversion.
cards.referenceTextZh: 会的。作为一个合格的/专业的飞行员，我会时刻做好好处理异常状况和改航的准备。飞行前我们将收到一个飞行计划。我们必须在飞行计划列出的备用机场中选出合适的改航机场，并考虑好改航情况。

cards.audioText: What are the reasons that may cause the diversion?
cards.audioTextZh: 可能造成改航的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Many factors may result in a diversion. For example, aircraft system failure en route, passenger becoming very sick during flight, the destination airport being closed because of bad weather or airport facility malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许多原因都可能导致改航。例如，途中飞机系统失效、飞行中乘客重病、因恶劣天气目的地机场关闭，或者飞机设备故障等。

cards.audioText: Who do you need to contact when you have to divert?
cards.audioTextZh: 不得不改航时，你应该联系谁？
cards.referenceText: First we need contact ATC to tell/inform him our intention to divert. We will request the weather condition at our alternate (airport), and we will also make a captain announcement to let the passengers know the situation. / Before diversion, flight crew shall contact ATC, and notify aircraft status and crew intentions, including alternate airport selected, flight route, flight level, estimated flight hour and capability of continuous flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我需要联系ATC告诉/通知他我们想要改航的想法。我们将向其询问备用（机场）的天气状况。之后机长会做通播，让乘客了解状况。/改航前，机组成员应该联系ATC，并告知其飞机状态和机组人员意图，包括可用的备降机场、航线、飞行高度层、预计飞行时间及连续飞行的能力。

cards.audioText: What will you do if one engine fails immediately after takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机起飞后立刻一发失效你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The most important thing is to keep calm. Firstly, I must keep maximum power of the operative engine so that we can achieve positive climb altitude. Then I should try to maintain a safe altitude. Meanwhile I should retard the affected engine thrust to idle and shut it down. And then I’ll pull out the related engine fire handle to discharge its fire bottle. Moreover, I'll report to ATC and request to return to land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 最重要的是保持冷静。首先，我必须把操作发动机控制到最大功率，以实现积极的爬升高度。之后我应尽量保持在一个安全的高度。同时我应阻止失效的发动机空转推车并关闭它。然后我将拔出失效发动机的灭火手柄，放到灭火瓶中。此外，我会报告ATC该情况，并要求尽快返航着陆。

cards.audioText: If the flaps cannot be deployed/ extended, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果襟翼打不开，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If we find that the flaps are jammed during preflight inspection/ preparation, we would delay our departure and request ground engineer/staff to solve the problem. If the flaps can not be extended during approach, I will report this situation to ATC and request the longest runway because the approach speed without flaps is very high. After touchdown, we can use the maximum brakes and reverser until full stop.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在飞行前检查或准备阶段发现襟翼被卡住，我们会延误出发，并请求地面工程师或工作人员来解决这个问题。如果在进近阶段襟翼不能展开，我会向ATC报告这一情况，并要求更换至最长跑道，因为没有襟翼的进场速度是非常快的。着陆后，我们可以使用最大刹车和反推力，直到完全停止。

cards.audioText: What is the function of MEL?
cards.audioTextZh: MEL的功能是什么？
cards.referenceText: MEL is short for Minimum Equipment List, it is a list of equipment that must be installed and operable for the aircraft to be considered airworthy. It is aircraft-specific and spells out which pieces of equipment may be inoperable while maintaining airworthiness. If something is found to be inoperative, the pilot goes to the MEL, finds the entry for that item, and determines if the airplane must be grounded until that piece of equipment is fixed.
cards.referenceTextZh: MEL是最低设备清单的英文简称，清单上的设备在安装和使用时必须充分考虑飞机的适航标准。这一飞机专用的清单指明了机上的哪些设备可能在飞行中失效。如果发现某些设备失效，飞行员会查看MEL，找到相关标准，以确定在完成修理之前是否必须停飞。

cards.audioText: Did you ever encounter unusual events during taxiing? Tell me about it.
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞机滑行过程中，你是否遇到过异常事件？讲一讲。
cards.referenceText: Yes. Once during taxiing, there was some debris on the taxiway which looked like pieces of a tire and some wreckage of aircraft or vehicle, immediately we reported to ATC. And after the taxiway was cleared, we continued taxiing to the runway. We were ready for take-off, suddenly, oil pressure low happened, we rejected the takeoff immediately. After we stopped on the runway and shut down the engine, we contacted ATC for taxiing back to the ramp and checked the aircraft by the maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过。有一次滑行阶段，滑行道上有一些碎片，看起来像是飞机或汽车轮胎的碎片，我们立刻把这一情况报告给ATC。清理完后，我们继续沿滑行道滑至跑道。准备起飞时，仪表突然显示发动机油压较低，我们迅速停止起飞。我们停在跑道上后立即关闭发动机。然后联系了ATC，准备滑行回停机坪并让维护人员检查飞机。

cards.audioText: Did you ever find dangerous objects on board, how did you handle that situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否在飞机上发现过危险物品，是如何处理的？
cards.referenceText: Yes, during the flight, the cabin crew had found a suspicious object in the overhead compartment on the left side of the first class cabin. We examined the object. It was very similar to an explosive or bomb because it had several dynamite sticks with a timer taped. The cabin crew moved the passengers and we immediately contacted ATC to declare emergency and requested ATC assistance and emergency services on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发现过，飞行过程中，机组人员在头等舱左侧的行李架上发现一个可疑物品。我们检查了该物品，几个炸弹管绑在一起并安装了定时器，看起来很像炸药或是炸弹。机组人员把乘客转移到安全的地方，我们迅速联系了ATC并告知其该紧急情况，请求在抵达时提供援救和紧急服务

cards.audioText: Do you know any cabin fire incident in your company? Tell me about it.
cards.audioTextZh: 你公司的航班发生过座舱失火事故么？讲一讲。
cards.referenceText: I know one cabin fire incident resulting from passenger smoking in the lavatory. They put the burning cigarette in the dust bin and wrapped up the tissues. The flight attendants put out the fire immediately. The fire was not so serious and the flight safety wasn’t affected. So, the pilots didn’t declare emergency and kept their flight continued.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我知道一起因为乘客在厕所吸烟造成的座舱失火事故。他们把未熄灭的香烟用纸裹起来，扔在垃圾桶里。还好乘务员及时把火扑灭了。火势并不严重，没有危及到飞行安全。所以飞行员没有宣布紧急状态，并继续飞行。

cards.audioText: In a twin engine aircraft, one engine fails, what action would you take? What are your procedures?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你驾驶一架双发飞机，起飞后立刻一发失效，你会怎样做？你的程序是什么？
cards.referenceText: I believe it is after V2 in this situation, so it is safe to continue taking off. When we reach certain altitude, we will do the memory items to restart the engine. We will have to return to the airport if we fail.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得这发生在飞机达到安全起飞速度后，所以继续飞行是安全的。到达一定高度时，我们会按照记忆项目完成相应的检查单项目。根据检查单的内容尝试重新启动或者返场备降。

cards.audioText: When will MEL be used?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么时候需要使用MEL？
cards.referenceText: If an item on the aircraft is found to be missing or inoperable, pilots will consult the MEL. If the item is found, the pilot will take proper actions required by the procedures document. Once the procedures are accomplished, the aircraft is ready to fly. If the item is not in the procedures document, the aircraft is grounded.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞机上的某个物品丢失或无法进行操作，飞行员将会执行MEL。如果物品被找到，飞行员将根据程序档案的要求采取适当行动。程序完成后，飞机可以准备飞行。如果物品未被包含在程序档案内，飞机将被停飞。

cards.audioText: If you encounter fuel leakage in flight, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行中遭遇燃油泄漏，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Follow the proper checklist: turn off the affected fuel pump; check fuel balance. Request diversion if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遵从规定的检查单：关掉相关的燃油泵，检查燃料平衡表。在必要时申请改航。

cards.audioText: In which situation do we need to evacuate? How do you prepare the evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么情况下需要紧急疏散？你怎样准备紧急疏散？
cards.referenceText: When the aircraft encounter emergency situation and the aircraft is in danger, we need to carry out emergency evacuation. Usually I will first communicate with cabin crew, then follow the procedure and assist passengers to complete the evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当飞机遇到紧急情况下，飞机处于非常危险的情况下，进行紧急撤离。通常会与乘务组协商做有准备的撤离，根据紧急撤离程序完成撤离。协助乘客做撤离的工作。

cards.audioText: What is the responsibility of cabin crew in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行当中遇到紧急情况时乘务员的工作？
cards.referenceText: The main responsibility of cabin crew in emergency situation is to ensure the safety of people onboard, which is also the origin of the job. The cabin crew should be calm to deal with the emergency situation, thus can help passengers and flight crew to safety evacuate from the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 紧急情况时乘务员的主要工作是保护飞机上人员的安全，这也是乘务员这个职业创立的初衷。所以乘务员在紧急情况下应该沉着冷静的面对紧急情况，并且帮助乘客和机组成员安全的撤离飞机。

cards.audioText: If your aircraft suffered from structural damage, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的飞机遭遇结构损伤，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: If our aircraft encounters structural damage, first, I will try to control the aircraft and let cabin comfort the passenger and ensure their safety belts are fastened. Then, I will inform ATC about my situation as soon as possible, and I will also request priority landing and emergency services. After landing, I will report structural damage to the mechanics for maintenance check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我的飞机遭遇结构损伤，首先，我会尽力操纵飞机，让乘务员安抚乘客，并确保他们安全带系紧扣好。然后，我会尽快联系管制员，然后我会请求优先着陆和紧急服务。着陆后，我会向机务报告结构损坏，做维修检查。

cards.audioText: If your aircraft is out of control during flight, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，如果你的飞机失控，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: If my aircraft is out of control during flying, first, I will try my best to regain the control of the flight. Then, I will report my situation to ATC and request priority and if necessary, I will also request emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我的飞机在飞行中失控，首先，我会尽力控制住飞机，然后我会将情况汇报给管制员，请求优先着陆；如有必要，我会申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: What pilot’s operating habits will lead to CFIT?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员的哪些操作习惯会导致CFIT？
cards.referenceText: Some pilot’s bad operating habits will lead to CFIT, for example, lack of cross check in the cockpit, using nonstandard terminology in radio telephony communication and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员一些不好的飞行习惯可能会导致可控飞行撞地，驾驶舱内缺少交叉检查，在陆空通话中使用不标准的术语等。
